place: Plai Laem, Bo Phut, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani, Thailand
title: Four-Bedroom Hillside Pool Villa with Sea Views, Gym and Chef's Kitchen
blurb: A furnished hillside villa with a 14-metre overflow pool, open-plan living and long views across the bay — four bedroom suites, a fully equipped gym and a separate chef's kitchen, backed by jungle on a 690 m² plot in Plai Laem.
detail:
Perched on the hillside above Plai Laem, this is a house designed around its view. Living, dining and kitchen share one generous open-plan room that slides out onto a terrace and a 14-metre overflow pool, so the whole ground floor reads as a single space from sofa to horizon. Jungle closes in at the back and along one side, while the front opens across the water — a rare mix of seclusion and easy access, minutes from the beaches, restaurants and shops of the north-east coast.

The interiors follow a contemporary bohemian line: pale marble floors laid in a chevron pattern, dark timber beams, deep indigo upholstery and a collection of furniture and artwork gathered from India, Bali, the Philippines and Thailand. It is layered and warm without feeling crowded, and the house is offered furnished, so the character comes with it.

Four bedroom suites, each with its own bathroom, are arranged for comfort and privacy, with a fifth bathroom for guests. Two features set the house apart from its neighbours: a large, fully equipped gym with a mirrored training hall, rack and cardio equipment, and a separate chef's kitchen that keeps the main living space clear when hosting — well suited to a family that entertains, or to a villa that also works as a high-end rental or wellness retreat.

The plot is 690 m², with about 360 m² of interior living space and roughly 500 m² in total once terraces, pool deck and covered parking are included. The villa is being offered privately and is not listed publicly; details, viewing arrangements and the full ownership structure are shared on request.
